taskDescription: Wave 8: Workflow Engine Integration & CLI Wiring - Connect the existing infrastructure (workflow executor, session manager, storage repositories, skill loader) to CLI commands. Wire the stub CLI commands to actual services for a functional MVP.

features.description: Feature 1: Create application container (internal/application/container.go) with dependency injection - Initialize SQLite connection, create repository instances, SessionManager, WorkflowExecutor, SkillLoader. Wire container into AppContext in root.go

Feature 2: Create SkillRegistry (internal/application/skills/registry.go) - Cache loaded skills, load from ~/.skillrunner/skills and embedded skills. Modify list.go to replace getMockSkills() with actual skill loading

Feature 3: Wire run command (run.go) - Load skill from registry, create provider from config, execute workflow with WorkflowExecutor, display phase progress with spinner, show results (phases, tokens, timing), support --stream flag
Feature 4: Wire session commands (session.go) - Get SessionManager from container, implement start/list/attach/detach/peek/kill/inject for managing AI coding sessions

Feature 5: Wire context commands (context_items.go, context_focus.go, context_checkpoint.go, context_rules.go) - Get repositories from container, implement add/list/remove for items, focus set/clear/show, checkpoint create/restore/list, rules management
Feature 6: Wire workspace commands (workspace.go) - Get WorkspaceRepository from container, implement init/list/show/switch, display workspace status with active sessions

Feature 7: Create ProviderInitializer (internal/application/provider/initializer.go) - Set up providers from config, check health (Ollama connection, API keys). Modify status.go to display provider status and available models
Feature 8: Wire ask command (ask.go) - Load skill from registry, execute first/specified phase only, route to provider based on profile, display response with optional streaming
